diagnosis: The checks C3 and C6 passed without the hidden information because the lone decision-maker could rely on default values and common practices. Specifically, C3 passed due to the 'written opt-in consent' default set by PF1, and C6 passed due to the 'prohibition on off-hours monitoring' default set by PF2.

C3.why: The exact enrolled population changes C2 to 620, and the Illinois-law finding changes C3 and C4 from unspecified or generic consent to written opt-in consent before collection.

C6.why: The collective bargaining agreement changes C5 to exactly 14 calendar days, C6 to a prohibition on off-hours monitoring, and adds the union-notice commitment in C10.
